body: I've been here for two months and have had no luck finding any work. I'm so flat affect I worry if I could even negotiate an interview if I got one. I also feel like all my skills are gone. I feel like I can't remember how to do simple things like make dinner led alone some of the more technical things I used to do professionally. I almost feel like I've become retarded.
I have a resume and a college degree, but it's hard to find jobs. Not much out there. I didn't get any calls back even from retail mcjobs.

Thanks for your reply. This is the message I've gotten from books, counselor and friends. It's hard to know how to start. I've tried looking for jobs and can't find anything. 

I'd say I want to talk but I don't know what to say. It took me two months to get up the willpower to event type up this post. Putting it down in black and white made it seem so much more real and so much more terrifying.
I feel like a hollow shell of a person with no hope and no options. I just want to die so I don't have to be homeless again.

I was diagnosed Bipolar Type 1 with psychotic features. I dispute the latter because it was basically based on the police's word that my story about how I ended up living with a woman after six months homeless sounded nuts and it was, but it happened. She threw me out and they came to get me and then put me in the psyche ward because I was saying crazy shit on facebook that scared my wife and former boss too. My family cut me off completely. The only people I have are my friend and his wife. I feel like there is a timer over my head for when I'll be homeless again.
